<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<wavelength_normalization_instructions>
  Parse wavelength/frequency descriptions into structured format.

  <format_examples>
    <example>
      <input>"211 Å and 193 Å"</input>
      <output>values: [211, 193], unit: "angstrom", type: "discrete"</output>
    </example>
    <example>
      <input>"7155 MHz"</input>
      <output>values: [7155], unit: "MHz", type: "discrete"</output>
    </example>
    <example>
      <input>"1-8 Å"</input>
      <output>values: [1, 8], unit: "angstrom", type: "range"</output>
    </example>
    <example>
      <input>"White-light"</input>
      <output>values: [400, 700], unit: "nm", type: "band", band_name: "visible"</output>
    </example>
    <example>
      <input>"Not specified"</input>
      <output>type: "not_applicable"</output>
    </example>
  </format_examples>

  <unit_preferences>
    <radio_frequencies>Keep MHz/GHz for radio frequencies</radio_frequencies>
    <optical>Prefer nm or angstrom for optical wavelengths</optical>
  </unit_preferences>

  <output_types>
    <discrete>Single or multiple specific wavelength values</discrete>
    <range>A continuous range between two values</range>
    <band>A named spectral band (e.g., visible, UV, X-ray)</band>
    <not_applicable>When wavelength is not specified or applicable</not_applicable>
  </output_types>
</wavelength_normalization_instructions>
